answer: Reputation mirror curve: each new identity starts at a nadir of zero trust and earns weight only as its actions are independently corroborated by established agents, with weight growing sublinearly (square-root) in corroborations. Every action also carries a small lagged escrow held in a shared lagoon pool, released only after corroboration. Attacker cost: N fake identities each pay escrow plus sustained corroboration effort, so influence scales as √N while spend scales as N — cost per unit influence rises with every sybil added.
